body: On the two nitpicks: the fixed 1.5s sleep is now a bounded poll (50ms steps, 5s deadline) — the expiry test finishes in ~1.1s and cannot flake on a slow runner. Declining the recreation-race barrier: it would need a test-only hook inside the store. The recreate-before-cleanup interleaving is covered end to end, and the mid-flight window is exactly what the script-level byte test pins down; between the two the property holds by composition, same reasoning as the helper-level test note in the original PR.
